set(CORE_CURL_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../xgdl/.deps/curl-install" CACHE PATH "")

set(XGCFG_BUILD_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(XGCRYPTO_BUILD_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(XGFS_BUILD_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(XGLOG_BUILD_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(XGNET_BUILD_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(XGNET_CURL_DIR "${CORE_CURL_DIR}" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(XGPROC_BUILD_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(XGSECURE_BUILD_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(XGZIP_BUILD_DEMO OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)

add_subdirectory(cfg)
add_subdirectory(crypto)
add_subdirectory(fs)
add_subdirectory(log)
add_subdirectory(net)
add_subdirectory(proc)
add_subdirectory(secure)
add_subdirectory(zip)
